audit: V1-A-R Area B: Frozen SA3/SA3-R Canonical Capability Disposition Matrix

dispositions.name: Codebase & Directory Inspection Baseline
dispositions.rationale: Essential global foundation for repository context and structure inspection.

dispositions.name: Minimalist YAGNI Engineering Doctrine
dispositions.rationale: Always-active core principle enforcing simplest, least-bloated solution.

dispositions.name: Verification-First & Empirical Evidence
dispositions.rationale: Core invariant requiring test proof before claiming success.

dispositions.name: Strict Sandboxing & Epistemological Containment
dispositions.rationale: Kernel security invariant preventing untrusted agent escalation.

dispositions.name: Git & SCM History Traversal
dispositions.rationale: Injected when git operations, commits, or diffs are targeted.

dispositions.name: Build System & Package Dependency Analysis
dispositions.rationale: Injected when package manifests and build configs are touched.

dispositions.name: Security Audit & Vulnerability Scanning
dispositions.rationale: Injected during security audit and authentication workflows.

dispositions.name: Refactoring & Structural Cleanliness
dispositions.rationale: Injected during multi-file refactoring and migration passes.

dispositions.name: Test Generation & Regression Containment
dispositions.rationale: Injected when test suites and assertions are authored or debugged.

dispositions.name: Accessibility Auditor Specialist
dispositions.rationale: Injected when agent is assigned accessibility auditing role.

dispositions.name: UI/UX Micro-Interactions Specialist
dispositions.rationale: Injected when agent handles frontend component layout and styling.

dispositions.name: Concurrency & Data-Race Specialist
dispositions.rationale: Injected for asynchronous concurrency, thread-safety, and actors.

dispositions.name: Performance & Memory Profiling Specialist
dispositions.rationale: Injected when analyzing traces, heap allocations, and bottlenecks.

dispositions.name: Platform Policy & Store Compliance Specialist
dispositions.rationale: Injected when verifying platform store guidelines and privacy manifests.
